lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, and no test achieved a statistically significant win.
Split-screen redesigns for adoption persona selection significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Adding new screens, hints, setup checklists, or wait indicators showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps, layout redesigns, copy updates, and path choice changes showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Teaser Screen Before Home
candidates.change: Inserts a new desktop interaction teaser screen before home intro showing an animation of the pet walking on desktop.
candidates.why: Support mail shows confusion on how to control or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step drops to 64.8% with high mean time.

new_desktop_teaser.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_teaser.body: Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Click and drag them around anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new interaction teaser screen inside onboarding before home intro is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens previously decreased finish step conversion significantly (-9.1%).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Friend Selection Screen
candidates.change: Reorders the onboarding sequence so users pick their friend pet before sign-in.
candidates.why: Adoption has low conversion (60.9%) and sign_in takes 567s mean time; picking a pet first increases user investment before sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to sync your companion across desktop sessions.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering onboarding steps showed no clear positive effect (-1.7%).

candidates.title: List Layout Redesign of Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout into a clean list view with pet traits.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops off significantly at 60.9% conversion and 89s median time.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Desktop Pet
pick_friend.body: Choose your primary desktop companion from the available pet list.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen layout preserves its function of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns previously worsened conversion performance by 9.4%.

candidates.title: Quick-Start Sound Preview Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds a pet audio voice preview screen (new_sound_preview) before completing adoption.
candidates.why: Support mails highlight confusion regarding how to talk to pets and post-onboarding feature misbehavior.

new_sound_preview.headline: Listen to Your Pet
new_sound_preview.body: Test pet sound effects and voice interactions before completing adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a new sound preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen in adoption step showed positive lift (+7.2%) despite general new screen risks.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Icon Navigation Copy on Home Intro
candidates.change: Updates the home intro text to explain how to reveal and talk to the pet via the system tray icon.
candidates.why: Support mails report confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Lives in Your System Tray
home_intro.body: Look for the pet icon in your taskbar or menu bar to hide, show, or interact with your companion anytime.

guard.reason: Updating text on the home intro screen is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change directly addresses support mail confusion, though copy updates generally have neutral impact.

candidates.title: Account Auto-Sync Safety Hint on Sign-In Screen
candidates.change: Adds a microcopy hint reassuring users that pet choices auto-sync to their account.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Your pet configuration automatically saves to this account so you never lose progress.

guard.reason: Adding account auto-sync microcopy on the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints previously had a slight positive lift (+1.5%) and address specific user support emails.

candidates.title: Preparation Step Checklist on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Replaces waiting status with a multi-step checklist showing desktop pet preparation progress.
candidates.why: Waiting screen on home step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-offs.

guard.reason: 'waiting.replace.wait_status[0]': a checklist cannot do the wait_status job (use ['animation', 'mascot', 'preview', 'progress', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel'])

candidates.title: Desktop Notification Toggle on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Enables a system desktop notification toggle when waiting so users can minimize the app.
candidates.why: Home step has a long mean duration of 2336s and users complain about pet not displaying.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding desktop notification settings to the waiting screen is permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Desktop notification toggles/alerts significantly worsened performance (-6.9%) in prior tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut Info Badge on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Adds a desktop shortcut status badge to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Support mails report 3 cases of pet not showing on desktop or app not opening.

components.text: Launch your pet anytime directly from your desktop.

guard.reason: Replacing adoption certificate components with a desktop shortcut badge loses the screen's required job of showing the adoption with an official stamp.

candidates.title: Compact Layout Redesign of Story Screen
candidates.change: Changes story screen layout to compact mode for faster path choosing.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet
story.body: Choose how you would like to create your companion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout to compact mode retains the job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns for path selection showed a slightly negative trend (-1.3%).

lessons_next: No onboarding changes tested achieved a statistically significant win.
Predictions were frequently too optimistic, though some negative predictions were overly pessimistic.
Split-screen persona selection redesigns significantly worsened performance.
Adding background processing desktop alert systems significantly worsened performance.
Reordering sign-in to after friend selection significantly worsened performance.
Copy updates, layout redesigns, new screens, hints, checklists, and wait indicators showed no clear effect.
